page_title: ROM 7-0 EMP | AS Roma v Empoli 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Luca Sacchi no option but to blow his whistle.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' AS Roma hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
86' 7 - 0 Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) finds some space inside the box and scores with a terrific header inside the right post, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
86' AS Roma earn a corner.
85' Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
84' The substitution has been made. Stiven Shpendi (Empoli) has replaced Nicolo Cambiaghi.
84' Here is a change. Leonardo Spinazzola is going off and Jose Mourinho gives the last tactical orders to Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
83' It is time for a substitution. Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) is on for Romelu Lukaku.
82' 6 - 0 Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) collects a killer pass and fires a low shot into the middle of the net, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
82' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

80' 5 - 0 Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the top left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 5:0.
78' Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
75' Substitution. Leandro Paredes walks off the pitch and Riccardo Pagano (AS Roma) comes on as a substitute.
73' Dangerous play by Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma). Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) hits a shot towards the top of the net from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Etrit Berisha.
69' Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

67' That was absolutely fantastic! Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the right post! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
66' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Rui Patricio is prepared and dives to thwart him.
65' Empoli are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
64' Today's match ends for Paulo Dybala who will be replaced by Andrea Belotti (AS Roma).
61' The ball goes out for a corner. Empoli can continue in their attacking effort.
60' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a change. Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) replaces Matteo Cancellieri.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mattia Destro leaves the pitch and Francesco Caputo (Empoli) comes on.
59' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) fires in the free kick from a promising position just outside the box. It's a fantastic strike and looks set for glory, but it only rattles the crossbar!
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Youssef Maleh (Empoli) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' 4 - 0 Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) gets in a good position after an exceptional individual run and releases a powerful shot that flies precisely into the bottom left corner.
53' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
52' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) commits a rough foul. Juan Luca Sacchi stops the game and makes a call.
50' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Jose Mourinho probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Renato Sanches (AS Roma). He is replaced by Edoardo Bove.
46' Paolo Zanetti makes a half-time substitution. Simone Bastoni comes on in place of Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli).
46' Half-time substitution. Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) will not participate anymore and Ardian Ismajli is coming on.
46' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jacopo Fazzini as he is replaced by Gabriele Guarino (Empoli).
46' The whistle blows and Juan Luca Sacchi starts the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
45+2' A corner kick by Empoli is thwarted by the well prepared Rui Patricio (AS Roma).

45+1' Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Rui Patricio thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' The ball goes out of play. Empoli are awarded a corner kick.
42' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
39' Renato Sanches (AS Roma) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
39' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) receives a yellow card.
38' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
35' 3 - 0 Alberto Grassi (Empoli) scores an own goal!
33' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
31' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
29' Empoli take a short corner kick.
28' The linesman makes the right call and Empoli will have a corner.
25' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
24' Empoli keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
22' Leonardo Spinazzola floats in a cross for Bryan Cristante (AS Roma), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and floats high over the bar.
19' AS Roma get a corner.
18' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) fires the ball against the bar direct from the corner kick. That was close!
18' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
14' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Etrit Berisha is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
14' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
12' The corner is swung in but Empoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' Empoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
8' 2 - 0 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Rasmus Kristensen is pounced on by Renato Sanches (AS Roma). His close-range header flashes past Etrit Berisha and into the left of the goal. 2:0.
6' The AS Roma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' 1 - 0 Goal! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Etrit Berisha into the top left corner.
2' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
2' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) handles the ball inside the box.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
